name: OpusClip
tagline: AI tool that turns long videos into short social clips.
best_for: Creators repurposing podcasts and long videos into shorts
description:
OpusClip analyses a long video, such as a podcast, webinar or stream, and proposes shorter clips suited to platforms like TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts. It reframes footage to vertical format and adds captions so clips can be posted with little manual editing.

It fits people who publish long-form content and want more short posts from the same recording. Treat the suggested clips as a first pass: review each one for context, accuracy of captions and a sensible start and end. Check the official site for current plans and limits.
